subject: Embedded assistant: SKU options, co-branding, and support path
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@convergeai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Partner inquiry — embedding an assistant into Converge UI

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking a look at this. Converge AI is exploring embedding a lightweight assistant into our web and mobile SDK. We liked Redwood's performance profile at the demo — primary asks from our product team:

- Clear SKU/price guidance for an embedded, co-branded assistant (hosted vs. dedicated)
- Branding rules: full white-label vs. co-brand (logo + footer)
- Support and SLAs for production customers (S1 escalation path)
- Telemetry/analytics surface we can show in our admin console

Attached is a 1-pager with our use case and expected monthly active users (~50k MAU). Would love to set a short call to map options and a PoC scope.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | Converge AI
Elena@convergeai.com

Attachments: Converge_Integration_OnePager.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@convergeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner inquiry — embedding an assistant into Converge UI

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the one-pager.

Quick notes before a call:
- We can support both hosted (shared) and Dedicated (reserved capacity) models for an embedded assistant. For 50k MAU the recommended path is hosted to iterate, then Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation once you land key enterprise customers.
- For white-labeling: options are 1) Redwood as an invisible backend (no branding) under a private deployment contract; 2) co-brand where Redwood is acknowledged in an about page + support footer (standard for hosted). Dedicated/private allows more flexible branding.
- Commercial: we have an OEM SKU that combines a per-call runtime fee + an integration support retainer. We should align on expected token volumes to size pricing.
- Support: S1/S2/S3 defined in our SLA; dedicated customers get 24/7 on-call escalation and named TAM.

Can we do a 30-minute call next Tue (10/6) 11:00am PT? I’ll bring Marissa (commercial lead) and Sergio (partnerships/technical). If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a short draft PoC scope for alignment.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Partner inquiry — Converge AI (PoC ask + SKU)

Team — forwarding Converge's one-pager (attached). They asked about embedding our assistant across web + mobile and are sensitive to branding and support paths. High level ask: white-label embedding with an enterprise rollout.

Things we should cover on the call (prep):
- Pricing options: hosted per-call vs. OEM monthly retainer + usage banding. Provide a back-of-envelope for 50k MAU (assume average 40 tokens per interaction, 0.8 interactions/user/month conservative).
- Branding/Redistribution: what concessions are OK for hosted vs. dedicated/private. Legal will want to know redistribution rights if they resell.
- Data flow & compliance: telemetry we expose, whether logs contain partner-specific PII, KMS options for keys, retention windows.
- PoC scope: duration (6–8 weeks), success criteria (latency p95 < 600ms on web; integration of admin telemetry), deliverables (integration guide + small SDK sample), and signoffs.

Marissa — can you draft two commercial bullets (hosted OEM + dedicated OEM) we can present on the call? Sergio — can you surface any partner enablement constraints (SDK runtime, mobile footprint) and list quick wins for the PoC?

Karthik

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@convergeai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner inquiry — embedding an assistant into Converge UI

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround. Call time 10/6 didn't work for us; can we do Thu 10/8 10:30am PT instead?

A few clarifications from product/ops:
- Branding: Converge would prefer no Redwood logo for our enterprise customers; co-branding acceptable for the integration marketplace. We can sign a private deployment addendum if needed.
- Security: we require KMS-managed encryption for customer-specific keys and per-customer telemetry partitioning.
- Metrics: we want a lightweight telemetry surface (calls/min, error rate, avg latency) that we can embed in our admin console; nightly aggregates ok.
- PoC ask: pilot against a single customer environment (not anonymized) to validate latency and support model. We attached a draft PoC scope.

Thanks — Elena

Attachments: draft_PoC_scope.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@convergeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner inquiry — embedding an assistant into Converge UI

Elena — thanks, all clear. Confirming next steps and owners below.

Mutual action plan (short):
1) Commercial proposal (Marissa) — two options: Hosted OEM with per-call tiers + 3-month integration retainer; Dedicated OEM with monthly reserved capacity + reduced per-call rate. Deliverable: one-page term sheet by Fri 10/09.
2) Technical feasibility (Sergio) — confirm SDK footprint for iOS/Android web, outline telemetry APIs and KMS patterns, PoC test plan. Deliverable: tech note + sample SDK stub by Tue 10/13.
3) Legal / redistribution check (Karthik) — loop in legal for private deployment addendum and reseller rights. Deliverable: list of clauses to expect by Wed 10/14.
4) PoC kickoff (mutual) — target start 10/21, 6-week pilot against one customer environment. Success criteria: p95 latency < 600ms for web flows; error rate < 1%; telemetry integrated into Converge admin.

Support path: for the PoC we will provide a dedicated escalation channel to our Partnerships on-call; full TAM assigned if they opt for Dedicated OEM.

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for Thu 10/08 10:30am PT and attach a short term-sheet draft to orient the call.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
